consumptionData.methodology: ADAC records manufacturer stated data for a current Golf 1.5 TSI Energy variant. The combined value is retained as official combined data. Category rates are estimated around it: urban is higher for short trips, interurban is lower for steady roads, motorway is higher for sustained high speed, and unknown uses the combined value.

sources.title: VW Golf 1.5 TSI ENERGY (ab 06/25)
sources.notes: Used for current Golf VIII facelift 1.5 TSI variant, 1498 cc displacement, and 5.3 L/100 km stated consumption.
